note: Forest Service place rules that this app QUOTES and does not draw. Every record here exists because the rule is real, published and findable, while its boundary is not. The Laguna Mountain Recreation Area is the case that forced the file: Cleveland National Forest states an archery-only rule for it in plain terms on its own website, and neither the Forest Service nor anyone else publishes a polygon or a metes-and-bounds description for it. It may therefore be quoted, cited and linked — and it may NEVER be drawn, approximated from a ranger-district boundary, or inferred from the recreation area's name. A hand-drawn line here would be this app inventing a federal boundary.
why_this_is_not_geometry: An undrawn rule and a drawn one are not interchangeable. A map layer answers 'am I inside it?' and this app cannot answer that for the Laguna Mountain Recreation Area, because no published boundary exists to answer it with. So the record answers a different question honestly — 'there is a rule here, these are its exact words, here is who published them, go and check where it applies' — rather than answering the first question with a guess.

notices.title: Laguna Mountain Recreation Area — Forest Service archery-only rule
notices.agency: USDA Forest Service, Cleveland National Forest
notices.boundary_status_note: The Forest Service publishes this rule without publishing a boundary for the area it applies to. There is no polygon in the Enterprise Data Warehouse for it and no metes-and-bounds description on fs.usda.gov. This app therefore quotes the rule and draws nothing. Being outside every line this app draws is not evidence that you are outside this area.

verbatims.text: Rifle, firearm, or crossbow hunting is not allowed at any time within the Laguna Mountain Recreation Area (only archery hunting during season).
No discharge of fire arms is allowed at anytime in the Laguna Mt. Recreation Area (only archery hunting is allowed during season).
verbatims.source_doc: Cleveland National Forest — Hunting, Laguna Mt. Recreation Area restriction

applies_near.note: Mount Laguna village, given so the app can offer this notice where a hunter around the Lagunas would look for it. It is a LANDMARK, not a boundary, and it does not mean the rule stops at any distance from it.

conflict_note.headline: Two governments, two rules, and they do not say the same thing
conflict_note.body: During D-16's general deer season state regulations authorise taking a deer with a rifle, and the Forest Service says no rifle, firearm or crossbow may be used inside this recreation area at any time. Both sides are quoted below in their own words, each with its own citation and the date this app read it. This app does not resolve them, and the Forest Service rule is one this app cannot show you the edges of.

state_rules.text: Except for the provisions of the following subsections (d) through (j), big game may only be taken by rifles using centerfire cartridges with softnose or expanding projectiles; bow and arrow (see Section 354 of these regulations for archery equipment regulations); or wheellock, matchlock, flintlock or percussion type, including “in-line” muzzleloading rifles using black powder or equivalent black powder substitute, including pellets, with a single projectile loaded from the muzzle and at least .40 caliber in designation.
state_rules.note: The rifle half of the disagreement, quoted rather than summarised. Without it this card asserted in its own voice that a rifle is lawful here and offered a quotation about crossbows as the evidence.
state_rules.source_doc: CDFW 2026-2027 Mammal Hunting Regulations p.21-22: 2026 Mammal Booklet v1_Final Draft_published_7.1_.pdf

state_rules.text: Except as provided in subsection 354(j) of these regulations, crossbows may be used to take deer only during the regular seasons.
state_rules.note: The crossbow half. It is a REGULAR-season rule, which is why this conflict is recorded against the general season and never against an archery hunt.
state_rules.source_doc: CDFW 2026-2027 Mammal Hunting Regulations p.21-22: 2026 Mammal Booklet v1_Final Draft_published_7.1_.pdf

federal_rule.text: Rifle, firearm, or crossbow hunting is not allowed at any time within the Laguna Mountain Recreation Area (only archery hunting during season).

conflict_note.not_a_conflict_during_archery: During hunt A-22 and during D-16's archery season there is NO disagreement about crossbows: state law already prohibits one. 14 CCR § 354(b) states that a crossbow is not archery equipment, and § 354(g) that "Except as described in subsection 354(j), crossbows may not be used to take game birds and game mammals during archery seasons." The exception in § 354(j) is the Disabled Archer Permit. Saying that CDFW permits a crossbow here and the Forest Service forbids it would tell an archer the state allows something it does not — which is why the conflict is recorded against the GENERAL season only.
